t: Im muttar lacharok shibbolim yachad vedine karmel
s: Im muttar lacharok shibbolim yachad vedine karmel ubo h' seipim: muttar lacharok shene shibbolim beyachad, veken muttar lemalleot qedera shibbolim leyabbesham betok hattannur, veen chosheshin shemma al yede chom haur yetzeu mayim mishshibbolet achat veyippelu al gabbe chabertah vetachmitz, lepi shemmayim ellu niqraim me perot veenan machmitzin. Veap leminhagenu sheanu machamirin bekol me perot, mikkol maqom en haddabar matzuy sheyyetzeu mayim mehashshibbolim, lepikak en chosheshin lazeh kelal, kevan sheap sheyyeera lipamim sheyyetzeu mehem mayim — en kan issur gamur shel tora, shehare ap lammachamirin bekol me perot meiqqar haddin, mikkol maqom en chimmutzah chimmutz gamur ella nuqsheh, veissuro middibre soperim:

Hashshibbolim o hachittim atzman shenniqlu battannur o baur, im techanan lo yebashshel haqqemach shellahem bemayim, shemma lo niqlu baur yapeh veyabou lide chimmutz betok hammayim qodem sheyyaspiqu lehitbashshel sham. Vaapillu im haqqemach atzmo niqla battannur — lo yebashshelennu bammayim, shemma lo niqla yapeh (veyabo lide chimmutz). Veyesh mattirin lebashshel qemach haqqaluy, lepi shechom haur sholet bo yoter mimmah sheshsholet behachittim. Veyesh lismok al dibrehem bediabad, sheim abar veasa mimmennu tabshil — yesh lehattiro bahanaa o lehashhoto ad leachar happesach:

Abal matztza apuya shechazar utechanah — muttar lebashshel haqqemach shellah velaasot mimmenna kol mah sheyyirtzeh. Apillu bemaqom shemmetzuyim abadim shemmezalzelim beissurim, en chosheshin shemma kesheyyiru shemmattirim laasot tabshil miqqemach shel matztza yitparetzu lehattir leatzmam laasot tabshil miqqemach shel chittim:

Vatiqa, vehu tabshil heasuy mishshemen umelach im qemach — muttar laasoto bepesach im en sham taarobet mayim kol shehu. Vaapillu bemelach shellanu shemmebashshelim oto mimmayim vahare dino kemayim, mikkol maqom kevan shehu muat venishtanna tzurato mitztzurat hammayim — en bo koach im hashshemen. Abal im yesh sham melach merubbeh — yesh lachosh ulehachamir kedin me perot im mayim shemmemaharim lehachmitz:

Keshemmolelin et haqqederot hachadashot, dehaynu shemmebashshelim bahem qemach umayim vechometz kede lehaqshotan ulechazzeqan, im hu betok happesach (perush: bechullo shel moed, ayyen siman tq"b) — lo yimlol ella beqemach shel matztza apuya, abal lo beqemach shel chittim:
